label: Finite models for the MUTABLE and GOD sense forks (mixed readings, omissions, nonvacuity)
paraphrase: Finite interpretations for the mutability and God forks: per term, a model in which coverage holds, exclusivity fails, the two uses are read in different senses (succession MUTABLE_1 and boundary MUTABLE_2; naming GOD_1 and attributes GOD_4), every other premise of the joint theorem holds and its conclusion fails; a nonvacuity witness per joint theorem; a model in which both the MUTABLE_2 and MUTABLE_3 boundary statements hold, the sense bridge fails and STMT-LIFE-BOUNDARY-REQUIRES-POTENCY fails; a model in which the bridge holds without a boundary premise and the root node fails; a model in which the GOD_1 naming (analytic), the GOD_2 reduced naming and the GOD_3 usage naming hold, something meets the full description, and STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-FULLY-DESCRIBED-PRINCIPLE fails; a model in which the GOD_3 bridge holds without the usage premise and the root premise fails; and a model in which every premise of GOD-EXISTS-FROM-MAXIME-ENS-CAUSING-ALL except the quarta via conclusion and excluded middle holds and nothing is God. Satisfiability and omission only; no model describes reality.
